Mechanic A: "Don't dawdle! Whatever it takes,
Mechanic E: "...Think the Chief's rubbing off on that one too?"
Mechanic B: "You there! Move your hands before your mouths!"
I'm pretty sure it's for Zeifon..."
Touya: "She doesn't seem to be here..."
Looks like they're arguing about something..."
Celica: "I told you, standing that close
gets in the way of my work. Understand?"
Celica: "Look, I'm glad you want to guard me,
but I can't move properly with you right next to me, can I?"
I'm telling you I'm fine. Understand?"
Celica: "Good. You're not allowed any closer than that. Got it?"
I don't like being addressed that way, you know?"
That's what I'll call you from now on."
Fain: "What is it? Do you need something?"
I told you to stay back!"
Celica: "Are you going to make me say it again?"
Oh, right. I haven't even introduced you to them yet."
Yamato: "Huh? N-Now that you mention it..."
Mechanic C: "The Chief seems down today.
Sob... Why would someone so wonderful... Damn it..."
Mechanic B: "...I know how you feel, but
we can't stand still. The Chief can't either."
Mechanic F: "The Chief's taken quite a shock too.
She's been working nonstop ever since."
Yamato: 'Does Chief mean Lady Celica, I wonder?'
Mechanic F: "Come on, don't keep crying forever.
Mechanic C: "Sob... I'm pathetic, aren't I...?
Everyone else is working so hard..."
Mechanic F: "Honestly, you never change, always so negative.
Here, wipe your tears with this. Come on, back to work!"
Mechanic A: "Hey! We're replacing Zeifon's armor.
Yamato: "Wh-When did you get behind us...?"
Touya: "...Well, I was an ordinary civilian until recently."
Mechanic E: "But you've got good eyes.
Celica: "Just Celica is fine. I don't like being addressed
That's what I'll call you from now on."
Have you taken a little interest in Spirit Mechs?"
You haven't met everyone yet, have you?
Celica: "Everyone! Stop work for a moment! Gather round!"
Celica: "Well, they're all mechanics from York.
They're not as good as me, but they're pretty capable."
Mechanic A: "There aren't many people who could
Celica: "He's the one who actually gives the orders.
You could say he's my best pupil."
...Pleased to meet you. I look forward to working with you."
Mechanic F: "Don't break things too badly."
I'm sure you've heard the rumors. He's Zeifon's pilot.
All right, everyone, back to work!
Mechanic A: "Roger! Back to your stations!"
Celica: 'Yes... With everyone working so hard,
Touya: "...Wait, are you maintaining all the Spirit Mechs
Celica: "Yes. Well, they're all professionals, so
we can work more efficiently than if we just added people.
Touya: "But it's still tough, isn't it?"
Celica: "It is. They're assembled, but they're still
Fain's been staring over here the whole time...
He looks really worked up, or...
He's just a little on edge."
Fain: "What is it? Do you need something?!"
Fain: "No, you definitely just called me."
Celica: "Fain! We made a promise, didn't we?!"
Fain: "No, it's just that I heard my name..."
Keep this up, and I'll have you get off the ship right now!"
Celica: "He keeps saying, 'I'll protect you no matter what,'
and won't leave my side. So..."
Touya: "But who is he protecting you from?"
Yamato: "He's trying to be considerate in his own way.
He noticed you're feeling down, Celica."
Celica: "...I understand how he feels, but...
If he comes over asking, 'Are you all right?' every time,
it just keeps reminding me... I need to forget soon..."
Touya: "I don't think you need to force yourself to forget."
People aren't made to work that smoothly."
Perhaps I was trying to escape by forgetting...
Yamato: "It's not fair to leave Fain like this, is it?
You need to tell him properly that you're all right."
Celica: "I'm all right now, so you don't have to keep doing this."
Celica: "Fain, thank you for being considerate.
Celica: "So you're free to do what you like.
I'll call you properly when I need you."
Fain: "A-Are you relieving me of my duty?!
Are you saying I'm not up to it...?"
Effective immediately, you're transferred to regular guard duty.
Thanks, Yamato. Oh, you too, Touya."
Oh, right. Would you help with some checks, if you don't mind?
I'd like to get data on the pilot's response coefficient too. How about it?"
Touya: "Huh? What are you springing on me...?"
Celica: "Since you've come all this way, why not?"
Sorry, I'm not in the mood.
Celica: "All right! Thanks for your hard work!"
Celica: "Karam water. It's a popular drink here.
It isn't a natural drink, but it's formulated to be close
to bodily fluids, so it's absorbed quickly."
Touya: "Huh... So it's like a sports drink?
Gulp, gulp, gulp... Aaah! Not bad."
Celica: "What do you mean? That's mine."
Celica: "There aren't any vending machines on this floor,
so everyone brings their own drinks.
Mechanic A: "Chief, we're done over here too!"
Celica: "Oh, I'm coming! See you, Touya.
Yamato: "An indirect kiss! An indirect kiss!"
Celica: "Aww, can't you help just a little?"
Touya: "You say 'a little,' but you're planning to do everything
you don't normally get a chance to, aren't you?"
Touya: "Besides, I'm not exactly free all day.
Celica: "Oh, Touya. Come to help again?"
Yamato: "Hey, isn't that the mech Fain was piloting?
Why's that the only one without its outer armor?"
Celica: "Oh, that one? Fain's reckless piloting
burned out the Prana transmission circuits. We're trying to repair it,
but with damage that bad, it may be impossible."
And he fights at full power, putting too much strain on the circuits."
Touya: "Huh... So he's not just some hot-blooded idiot
Celica: "He has power, but he doesn't quite know what to do with it.
Anyway, we'll do everything we can.
...Well, I'd better give it another try."
Touya: "I see. Sorry to bother you."
